method: 75 deterministic input-coordinator scenarios with production tr/en packs and FakeDocument. No device UI automation or production algorithm changes. Selected external text injected with hostRewrites; tracked selection composed through actual letter events and committed with field protection to retain the intended surface.

findings.observation: Typing and selecting the original admits the word. Selecting it from existing text and choosing the same original does not admit it, both with tracked and synthetic selection evidence.
findings.cause: pickSuggestion returns an empty report in selection-edit mode; perform only calls acceptPersonalSurface when report.kind == suggestion.

findings.observation: All 11 uppercase-containing external selection probes produced no suggestions; all 11 tracked counterparts did. Both lowercase external controls produced suggestions.
findings.cause: Synthetic selection calls layout.centerTouches(for: sel) without Turkish lowercase normalization; KeyLayout has lowercase keys.

findings.observation: With +0.2 key-width/height drift, context windows of 4,8,9 characters permit the bad correction. Full context and windows of 10,14,64 preserve input. Center and -0.2 probes remain unchanged.
findings.cause: Guard checks full composing display plus apostrophe and a preceding base character in current host context. Short host context omits the needed prefix.
findings.limitation: Boundary test for limited host context; no claim that a named application uses these window sizes.

findings.observation: After adoptDetachedSurface, an original suggestion is displayed but choosing it adds no separator and does not learn.
findings.cause: SuggestionPresenter emits current display, but pickSuggestion rejects detached state. InputSession.release can enter this state on recorder failure.
findings.limitation: Recovery state injected directly in test; no real recorder failure triggered.

controls: Explicit original choice during normal typing preserved casing for all 13 surfaces tested.
Known vocabulary words are not added to the personal dictionary; this is not classified as a learning failure.
